scope: Selected primary sources, precise reading ranges, claims and limits. does_not_support contains claims explicitly NOT established by that source. Not a systematic review. Full papers excluded.

sources.title: The Real Story Behind Story Problems: Effects of Representations on Quantitative Reasoning

sections: Difficulty Factors Assessments: Studies 1 and 2 (methods and results)
Conclusion and expert blind spot discussion

sources.design: Two matched-representation difficulty-factor assessments; n=76 and n=171 beginning algebra students; story, word-equation, and symbol-equation presentations; numeric and unknown-position factors.
supports: Symbolic decoding is not automatically easier than verbally stated mathematics for beginning algebra learners.
Reader prerequisites must be assessed separately from semantic equivalence.
does_not_support: More English is better for every mathematics domain.
An effect size for ReadFlow/P2/P3 or long advanced textbooks.
Direct causal validation of the proposed symbolization checklist.
sources.redistribution: Source PDFs are working evidence only; exclude full external papers from public deliverables; deliver citations and original examples.

sources.title: Translation Difficulties in Learning Mathematics

sections: Students-and-professors problem, samples and error rates
Word-order matching, static comparison and operative translation

sources.design: Reports written responses of 150 calculus-level students and 47 college-algebra nonscience majors; also 15 think-aloud interviews.
supports: English-to-algebra translation can reverse relationships even when the relation appears simple.
Type/quantity meaning and operational checking matter; literal word matching is insufficient.
does_not_support: Error frequency for AI rewriting or modern graduate learners.
A universal estimate of symbolization risk.
A controlled demonstration that this report’s prompts improve learning.
access_limitations: Author URL with tilde repeatedly returned 502. URL without tilde yielded a readable 5-page web extraction once, but direct download and screenshot later returned 502.
Printed page 288–289 read; the mismatch between publisher start page and author cover is recorded, not silently resolved.

sources.journal: Journal of Experimental Psychology: Learning, Memory, and Cognition

sections: Stimuli, methods and main results of Experiment 1

sources.design: Four algebra-validity judgment experiments manipulate perceptual grouping; Experiment 1 recruited 51 undergraduates and analyzed 44 after stated exclusion; selected detail read, not all four experiment sections exhaustively.
supports: Visual grouping and spacing can affect parsing of symbolic arithmetic/algebra.
A symbolically correct expression also needs visual inspection for grouping.
does_not_support: LaTeX page-break rules or a 1750-character threshold.
A direct effect on high-level proof reading or ReadFlow preferences.
